auditor_value: F_min = μmg/√(1+μ²) = mg sinλ with tanλ = μ = 1/√3 (λ = 30°) ⇒ 25 × 0.5 = 12.5 kgf (≈ 122.5 N)

findings.quote: Writing mg sin²θ in the last step instead of mg sinθ gives 6.25 kgf instead of the correct 12.5 kgf.
findings.note: This solution's last step is F_min = μmg/√(1+μ²); it never writes the form mg sinθ, so 'in the last step' points at a step that is not in the served solution. The number 6.25 kgf (25 × sin²30°) is correct for the error described in the alternative form F_min = mg sinθ.
findings.fix: Using the alternative form F_min = mg sinθ (with tanθ = μ, so θ = 30°) but squaring the sine, mg sin²θ = 25 × 1/4 = 6.25 kgf, instead of mg sinθ = 12.5 kgf.

notes: Independent solve agrees with option (c). Every equation line follows; μmg/√(1+μ²) evaluates to exactly 12.5 kgf. common_mistakes[2] (horizontal pull μmg = 25/√3 ≈ 14.4 kgf) computes as stated. The given 1 kgf = 9.8 N is not needed because the options are in kgf.
